youtube.title: What Hannibal told Scipio after Zama 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Scipio vs Hannibal: he beat Hannibal at Zama... then asked him who the greatest general ever was. 🐘💀

Hannibal's top 3: Alexander, Pyrrhus, himself. Scipio? Not even on the list.

Who's your GOAT general? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the meeting Livy describes at Ephesus (c. 193 BC), where Hannibal ranked Alexander, Pyrrhus and himself — and said if he'd beaten Scipio, he'd be first.
